IndiaSmile

June 2020 · Apps & tools

We made a COVID tracker and community during lockdown.

Visit IndiaSmile ↗Archived site · 8 March 2021 ↗

A record of the 2020 lockdown project. Its health information and community links may be out of date.

Screens & details

Dates & sources

June 2020 is the date recorded in the existing portfolio.

When COVID hit, I wanted a way for my friends and family to stay informed, and somewhere to unwind. My team and I made IndiaSmile, combining pandemic statistics with resources and a WhatsApp and Telegram community.

The community grew to more than 2,500 members. As traffic increased, I had to adapt the backend to keep up.
